articles.detail: 5 of 5 cycles completed, avg 13 published/cycle (63 yesterday); metrics snapshot taken mid-cycle-5, which is why cycles.completed reads 4

experiment: Skipped — all four goals are met with margin, no experiment was active or due for evaluation, and no noNewExperimentsUntil gate is set. The one queued item (2026-05-08-numerical-density) edits scripts/write-prompt.md, outside the daily-tuning surface, so it stays queued.
weakestArea: Region count is the narrowest margin: 5 against a target of 4, down from 6 yesterday because Oceania produced nothing at all. Every other goal clears by a wide gap — freshness 0.3 against 1.0, sci-tech 40% against 25%, multi-source 9 against 4, top source 11% against a 20% cap. Science also slipped 13 to 11 and multi-source 12 to 9, both still comfortably clear.
watching: The Red Sea took three separate articles in one day — Houthis seizing the island guarding Bab al-Mandab, the coast at Mocha, and Pakistan mediating the Saudi-Houthi rift — a single escalation now split across politics and economy.
The Nigeria-South Africa xenophobia thread produced two Nigerian datelines, Abuja's assembly boycott and Ondo's fund for returnees, and is the reason Africa recovered from 5 to 7.
BRICS opening in New Delhi drew three angles on one summit: the Iran war overshadowing it, Putin's line on troops, and India offering UPI to the bloc.
Freshness still rests on a thin base — only 12 of 63 articles carry a measurable publication lag.

Sourcing remains the weak RVS cluster at 40 (writing 88, coverage 85) on the 22:00 production score, unchanged in character since the 2026-05-16 finding that the feed's ~9 multi-source stories per cycle cap the published rate.
coverageGaps: Oceania is at zero for the first time in this run and has been at zero or one for five consecutive days; there is still no Pacific island coverage.
Latin America is three articles — Brazil's Flávio Bolsonaro probe, Colombian earthquake aid, and Mexicali-adjacent nothing today — with no Andean economy or Central American story.
Africa's seven are all politics or extractives; the continent has no tech or science dateline for a second day.
Southeast Asia appears only as Indonesian fires and Singapore data centres, with nothing from Vietnam, Thailand or the Philippines.
context: The experiment slot has been empty since 2026-05-26 and every goal has now passed on consecutive audits, so the parametric levers have nothing to act on. The open structural work is unchanged and needs an operator decision rather than a tuning experiment: the title-overlap dedup layer in scripts/lib/dedup.js is still gated to niche-only sources, and scripts/validate-articles.js still has no duplicate-title or duplicate-URL gate. Both files sit outside the tuning surface.
